titulo_fr: Une chronique culturelle : Repérer les informations
intro: Distinguish description, example and opinion in a chronicle about a cultural practice. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Distinguish description, example and opinion in a chronicle about a cultural practice. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: Relatives specify to which person or activity the text refers; opinion markers indicate interpretation. In this fragment, «atelier» means «workshop».

frases.fr: Dans le village de Saint-Loup, des bénévoles organisent chaque été un atelier de fabrication de masques.
frases.es: En el pueblo de Saint-Loup, voluntarios organizan cada verano un taller de fabricación de máscaras.
frases.en: In the village of Saint-Loup, volunteers organize a mask manufacturing workshop every summer.

frases.fr: Cette tradition, qui se transmet depuis plusieurs générations, attire aussi des visiteurs.
frases.es: Esta tradición, que se transmite desde hace varias generaciones, también atrae a visitantes.
frases.en: This tradition, which has been transmitted for several generations, also attracts visitors.
